sources.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack

stories.summary: Hackers drained about $6.3bn from Binance's hot wallets on Thursday, which The Block calls the largest crypto hack on record; the FBI attributed it to North Korea's TraderTraitor group on Saturday. When withdrawals reopened on Sunday, customers pulled a net $3.64bn in under ten hours, about 2.1% of Binance's $171bn in assets.

stories.summary: Brent fell to about $110 a barrel and US crude to about $101 on Monday morning after Axios reported Trump told Netanyahu he wants to give talks with Tehran more time before further strikes. Trump said the war would end soon 'one way or the other'. Ships in the Strait of Hormuz are still being attacked, so risk premiums stay high, and UBS expects Brent near $110 at year-end.

sources.title: Bank of England expected to raise interest rates to 4%

stories.summary: The Bank of England is widely expected to raise Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4% on Thursday, its first rise since August 2023, and markets already price the move. Fuel costs tied to the Middle East conflict and a forecast 22% jump in the energy price cap in January are pushing inflation further above the 2% target.
